@echo off
title game - recompiled by CodeBreaker
cd /d "%~dp0"

rem locate a built executable (build layout varies by generator)
set "EXE="
if exist "build\game.exe" set "EXE=build\game.exe"
if exist "build\Release\game.exe" set "EXE=build\Release\game.exe"
if exist "build\Debug\game.exe" set "EXE=build\Debug\game.exe"

if "%EXE%"=="" (
    echo First run - building game with CMake...
    where cmake >nul 2>nul || (echo(  CMake not found in PATH. Install CMake, then run this again. & pause & exit /b 1)
    cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build --config Release
    if exist "build\game.exe" set "EXE=build\game.exe"
    if exist "build\Release\game.exe" set "EXE=build\Release\game.exe"
    if exist "build\Debug\game.exe" set "EXE=build\Debug\game.exe"
)

if "%EXE%"=="" (
    echo(  Build did not produce game.exe - see the output above.
    pause & exit /b 1
)

echo Launching game ...
"%EXE%"
echo.
echo game exited.
pause
